findings: Prop. 4's proof (benzecri1960_ch3.tex:609-610, « un automorphisme projectif de w est un élément de GP(n, R) qui permute entre elles les variétés distinguées simples ») cannot be read as producing a compatible automorphism with torus factor t = 1 (f = F⁻¹(φ)). On the open segment w = simplexO 1 of S(1) (p = 2, each Bᵢ a point of S(0)), for EVERY projective isomorphism Ψ : F⁻¹(F(B₀) × F(B₁)) ≃ w, some projective automorphism of w is, transported, compatible (IsCompatiblePi, as Prop. 4 says) but every representation f = t ∘ F⁻¹(φ) has t ≠ 1 (simplexO_one_prop4_tore with torus_ne_one_of_not_compatibleOne). The cause: the only conical automorphism of F(B) ≅ ℝ₊*, B a point of S(0), is the identity (OpensZero.coneIso_eq_self; a conical map is ±1 in the global chart), so at most p! automorphisms are compatible with t = 1 (PointFactors.ncard_compatibleOne_le), while w has the infinitely many automorphisms s(diag(1, j+1)) (Segment.infinite_aut). This is evidence for OQ-171, not a refutation of Prop. 4: Prop. 4 as printed is TRUE in the reading with a torus factor (prop4_produit). No not_ declaration: nothing printed is refuted; the refuted object is a reading of the proof.
questions: OQ-171 (OPEN): whether « élément de GP(n, R) » in the proof of Prop. 4 is meant with the torus factor of Déf. 2 (ℝ^{+p}/ℝ^+). This file proves the reading t = 1 fails on the open segment; the reading taken by the strict library (t a free element of PiTorus) is untouched. The author rules.

kb_proposals: For B a one-point open of S(0), the only IsConeIso 0 0 automorphism of FCone 0 B is the identity: chartAt (RnO 1) y is definitionally OpensCone.gcc (FCone.proj y) (rfl), so IsConeIso.exists_smul_eq at y = x gives gcc(φ x) = g • gcc x with g ∈ GU(1) = ±1, and the ray constraint forces g • v = v (OpensZero.coneIso_eq_self).

To show 'some automorphism is not of type X' without computing Ψ: bound {f | X f} by a finite set (uniqueness per permutation, range of Perm (Fin p)), and use Set.Finite.preimage (transport injective).infinite_compl.nonempty against an Infinite instance (Infinite.of_injective on ℕ).

Stating `f • (ConeBase.mk x : PiBase k (fun i => ⟨_, hB i⟩))` in a theorem whose PiBase is over an Opens structure literal times out at typeclass; state such clauses generically over an abstract B (torus_ne_one_of_not_compatibleOne) and consume them.
A one-dimensional element g of GU(1) with g v ∈ ℝ₊ v is the identity: g = c • id (Fin 1 functions are multiples of v), LinearEquiv.coe_det + LinearMap.det_smul give |c| = 1 (GUR_one_smul_eq_self).
